note: Skill trainers: each has a lesson (Learn chapter 11) and a practice round of six positions from items[pool]. Items come from engine self-play (packages/chess-core/tools/generate-trainers.js, generate-mates.js) and are checked by test/content.test.js.

trainers.name: Openings
trainers.line: Start strong: take the centre, wake your pieces, keep your king safe.

trainers.name: Time Management
trainers.line: Beat the clock with quick, sure moves.

trainers.name: Resourcefulness
trainers.line: Things look bad? Find the move that saves the game.

trainers.name: Advantage Capitalization
trainers.line: You are ahead. Find the move that keeps the win.

trainers.name: End Game
trainers.line: Few pieces left: kings march and pawns promote.

trainers.name: Tactics
trainers.line: Forks, pins and tricks that win pieces.

trainers.name: Blunder Prevention
trainers.line: Spot the trap, then play a safe move.

trainers.name: Intuition Trainer
trainers.line: Three moves, a few seconds. Trust your eye.

trainers.name: 360 Trainer
trainers.line: See the board from their side, then stop their plan.

trainers.name: Retry Mistakes
trainers.line: Try again the moments that went wrong in your games.

trainers.name: Defences
trainers.line: Under attack? Find the move that holds.
